description: This file is a PHP script for rendering the edit or create view of a module in the vtiger CRM system, handling form display, data retrieval, validation, and template assignment.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: CRM entity class providing instance retrieval for modules.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class customized for vtiger CRM.
